items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: No, I think he went earlier with Benny Carter or something.

ctx.x: No I didn't take a group but a group went. They had Benny Goodman, Teddy Wilson, and Milt Harry Hinton, Shelly Mann, / Edison. Lockjaw was there.
Oh. Was Gus Johnson on that one?
No, I think he went earlier with Benny Carter or something.
